files.summary: Single source-of-truth hook for active regional metric. URL query `?region=` is canonical; popstate listener handles back/forward; invalid values fall back to null.

Unified top-right map toolbar. Replaces the legacy right-3 top-3 z-10 flex row that stacked RegionalLayerControl + StateSelector + visibility badge + drill-down helper. Single flex-wrap row with max-width and outside-click dropdown closure.
MAP_Z z-index token system (basemap 0 → modal 50) with paired CSS variable names. Single source of truth — literals like z-10/z-20/z-30 are forbidden inside src/components/map/.

41 pure-logic / source-text assertions: URL parser, regional metric allow-list (cost is forbidden), z-index token system, MapToolbar contract, RegionalLayerControl options, MapShell source invariants, RegionalLegend visibility, Tailwind tokens, style.load preservation, Stage 7B-A checkpoint + data invariants.

Removed legacy <MetricTabs> invocations (desktop + mobile sub-bar). Replaced useState<RegionalMetricId|null>(null) with useRegionalMetric() hook. Removed showStateDropdown local state (now owned by MapToolbar). Replaced z-10/z-20/z-30 literals with z-map-toolbar / z-map-legend / z-map-profile / z-map-control tokens. Mounted <MapToolbar> in place of the inline toolbar div.

Added data-testid='regional-layer-control' on outer div and data-testid='regional-layer-control-select' on select element. Source option set is now sourced from REGIONAL_METRIC_IDS so the dropdown stays in sync with the hook's allow-list.
Added data-testid='regional-legend' on outer div. Existing activeMetricId === null guard preserved (legend hidden when no heatmap).
Added zIndex extension with 11 named tokens (map-basemap / map-region / map-city / map-marker / map-hover / map-control / map-toolbar / map-legend / map-tooltip / map-profile / map-modal).
